notes: RTT-003 design pilot (IQ-10). The FULL FILM is not rendered in this session; this config defines it so the pilot clips (which extend it) and the length estimate come from one place. Drawn by the RTT-002 player (kits/rtt-002/player_rtt.html) in its quarter-end series mode; every RTT-003 feature is switched on here and is off for RTT-002.

Approved design (DEC-085, Luke 2 Oct 2026): console name + picture + maker colour on each bar; values in millions with '+' for lower bounds; maker key with logos; retired consoles fade (data fade dates); crown on the leader; estimated look (DEC-090) and the analyst-estimate label (DEC-084); title says units shipped; quick 1985-88 (DEC-097); RTT-002 pacing approach (DEC-068); callouts at crown changes only; company scoreboard tested in one clip (maker_key.scoreboard).

Working choices for Luke (DEC-103 onwards): 12 rows; maker colours; bar names from data/rtt-003/consoles.csv; one decimal; the beat glide; the key panel's place (the old car box, bottom right); the callout wording and line under the title.

pacing: RTT-002's rule (DEC-068) on quarter ends: sec_per_event 1.0 s x 1.4 (top-12 order changed) / 1.0 (a top-12 bar grew) / 0.8 (quiet, or the 4th+ unchanged quarter in a row); quarter ends up to 31 Dec 1988 at 0.5 s (DEC-097); 2.0 s hold on each change of first place (as RTT-002's record pauses); final table 10 s (DEC-070); no title or closing card.
No music (IQ-10). Pictures and logos are private (race-through-time-private assets/rtt-003/icons, logos; DEC-060), loaded from RTT_LOCAL_ASSETS; never committed here.
